scenario.intro: You rebalance a portfolio you already hold: the calculation starts from the positions and the cash you bring into the plan, counts them, and moves the whole as close as possible to the target weights. It is a simulation: no order is sent.

positions.title: Positions
positions.help: What you hold of this Asset, Broker by Broker, as LibreFolio records it today. The plan starts from these quantities: you can change one to simulate a different portfolio; LibreFolio is not changed.
positions.quantityHelp: The units of the plan: your part of what the Broker holds. Change it to plan on a different quantity.
positions.custodyHelp: The units the Broker holds on the account, and your share of the account when it is shared.

brokers.cashOnlyHint: No order here: its cash counts in the portfolio, and the plan can move it to the Brokers where it buys. Edit it in the Liquidity step.
brokers.positionsOnlyHint: Its positions count in the portfolio, but the plan buys and sells nothing here and does not use its cash. Add it to the plan to trade here too.
brokers.addToPlanFailed: The Broker could not be read: nothing was added.

targets.addCashHelp: A Broker's cash in one currency becomes a row of the targets, with a target and limits, like an Asset.
targets.addCashNone: Every Broker and currency of the scenario already has a cash entry.
targets.intro: How to split the total that enters the plan, cash included, in percent.
targets.introTotal: How to split the total that enters the plan ({total}), cash included, in percent.
targets.nowHelp: Today's weight of this row on the total that enters the plan. Information only: it is not a target.
targets.wire: The share of the total that enters the plan this row should have at the end, in percent. Decimals are allowed.
targets.limitsHelp: Minimum and maximum of this row's value at the end of the plan. Write an amount in the valuation currency (500) or a percentage of the total that enters the plan (35%). Empty field = no limit.
targets.totalHelp: The targets split the total that enters the plan, positions and cash included: to calculate, they must add up to exactly 100%. «Balance all» rescales every target keeping their ratios (equal parts if they are all 0). Tick some rows to rescale only those. «Balance to 100%» on a row gives it what is missing, or takes away the excess.

limitsGuide.percent: A percentage: «35%» means 35% of the total that enters the plan.
limitsGuide.percentTotal: A percentage: «35%» means 35% of the total that enters the plan, {total}.

targets.nowOtherCash: of which cash without an entry: {weight}

review.brokers: {operative, plural, one {# Broker} other {# Brokers}}{external, plural, =0 {} one { · # external account} other { · # external accounts}}{held, plural, =0 {} one { · # with positions only} other { · # with positions only}}
review.assets: {count, plural, one {# Asset} other {# Assets}}{positions, plural, =0 {} one { · # position} other { · # positions}}{missing, plural, =0 {} other { · # without a price}}{stale, plural, =0 {} one { · # price not of today} other { · # prices not of today}}
review.targets: {count} of {total, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} with a target

strategy.investOnlyHelp: It uses the cash to buy what is below target. It sells nothing.
strategy.investAndSellHelp: It can also sell, to get closer to the target. It estimates fees and taxes: it needs the Tax step.
strategy.fidelityLead: How much putting back what is off target is worth to you.
strategy.fidelityHelp: The plan spends on fees, to put back money that is off target, at most what the table below accepts for that amount. The higher the fidelity, the more it accepts to spend.

fidelityNote.costAware: It moves only for large deviations.
fidelityNote.faithful: It moves for small deviations too.
fidelityNote.targetFirst: It pays any cost to get closer.

strategy.customSentence: With {reference} in the wrong place I accept to spend up to
strategy.customLabel: The most you accept to spend for the reference row

table.title: Maximum acceptable cost
table.lead: The most the plan may spend, in fees and taxes, to put that money back. If it costs more, it leaves it where it is.
table.leadTotal: The figures hold for your total of {total}.
table.targetFirst: «Target first» has no maximum: it first gets as close as it can, then picks the way that costs least.
table.incomplete: The figures appear once the fields marked in red are complete.
table.unavailable: The figures are not available right now; the calculation is not affected.

plan.sequenceHint: Follow the numbers: first the deposits, transfers and currency exchanges, in the order shown, then the purchases.

allocation.beforeShareHelp: Its share of the whole portfolio today, cash included.
allocation.beforeValueHelp: What the entry is worth today: the units you hold at the quote price, or the cash.
allocation.targetShareHelp: The share you chose for this entry in the Targets step, of the whole portfolio.
allocation.targetValueHelp: What the entry would be worth with exactly its target share of the whole portfolio today.
allocation.finalShareHelp: Its value after the plan, as a share of the whole portfolio today, cash included. What the plan spends on fees and taxes is in the «Costs and fees» row.
allocation.finalValueHelp: What the entry is worth after the plan: the units you hold plus the ones bought, or the cash left.
allocation.boughtHelp: The value of what the plan buys of this Asset, at the quote price: without fees or price margin.
allocation.residualHelp: Value after the plan minus ideal value: positive if the entry ends above its share, negative if below.
allocation.minimumHelp: The minimum you set for this entry in the Targets step: its value after the plan does not go below it.
allocation.maximumHelp: The maximum you set for this entry in the Targets step: its value after the plan does not go above it.
allocation.title: Allocation per entry
allocation.untargetedCashHelp: The cash with no target of its own and the contributions the plan does not deposit. Before the plan it is everything that is neither in an Asset nor in a cash entry with a target; after it, the same without the money the plan spends on costs.
allocation.costsHelp: What the plan spends: fees, exchange spreads, price margins, taxes and rounding. Nothing before the plan. With the cash with no target it makes up what is not invested.

kpi.valueTodayHelp: The whole portfolio today: the Assets you hold at their quote price, plus every cash and contribution chosen for the plan.
kpi.valueAfterHelp: The whole portfolio after the plan: the Assets and the cash left. It is today’s value less the costs and fees.
kpi.valueAfterHeld: in {assets, plural, one {# Asset} other {# Assets}} and {cash, plural, one {# cash} other {# cash entries}}
kpi.moneyLostHelp: What the plan costs you: fees, currency exchange spreads, price margins, taxes and rounding. Today’s value less this is the value after.
kpi.largestDeviationHelp: How far the entry furthest from its target is, after and before the plan, in percentage points: the gap between its share and its target share. Assets and cash with a target count; the uninvested does not.
kpi.finalCashHelp: All the cash at the end of the plan, in the valuation currency: the cash entries with and without a target and the contributions not used. Under it, currency by currency and each in its own: how much there was at the start and how much is left.

header.scoreHelp: The score the plan minimizes: λ × distance/F + costs and fees. Here λ {lambda}, distance/F {distance}, costs and fees {lost}.
header.distanceHelp: How far the portfolio ends from its targets, in money: the squared gaps of every entry over the whole portfolio. «Target first» makes it as small as it can, then the costs and fees.

help.transfer_in: What arrives in this cash from another Broker of the plan.
help.transfer_out: What leaves this cash for another Broker of the plan.
help.funding_in: The deposits of your contributions into this cash.
help.funding_out: Always 0 in the Rebalancer: money moves between Brokers as transfers, in their own columns.
help.alwaysZeroInvestOnly: Always 0 with «Invest only»: the plan only buys.

proof.tieBreaks: Tie-breaks, among the plans as good on the objectives above
proof.fixedOrder: a fixed order of Assets and Brokers
proof.sameData: A search that ends by itself gives the same plan for the same data; one stopped by the time limit may give another.

help.status: Whether the solver closed this stage. Finished: it proved the best value. Unfinished: it stopped at the time limit, or, for a tie-break, its plan was set aside because it was no better, in exact arithmetic, on the objectives above. After a stage that stopped, the later ones only searched among plans as good as the one already found, so a gap of 0 there proves nothing.

help.optimalProven: The solver proved that no plan has a better score (with «Target first»: a smaller distance from the targets, then lower costs and fees), and the exact check of the plan matches its numbers. The tie-breaks after it may have stopped earlier: they only choose among plans just as good. The proof holds within the solver's small calculation margin, which grows with the amounts.

limit.tieBreak: The plan is proven the best on its objective; the limit stopped a tie-break, so an equally good plan may exist.

exposure.scope: On the whole portfolio, cash included
exposure.belowTarget: After the plan: below the target
exposure.aboveTarget: After the plan: above the target
exposure.onTarget: After the plan: in line with the target
exposure.title: Exposures – today, after the plan, target
exposure.help: How the whole portfolio, cash included, spreads by Asset type, sector and country: today, after the plan, and your target. The cash is the last row of each chart. The charts do not change the plan.

allocation.bounds_min_sum_exceeds_reference: The minimums add up to {minimums}: more than the total that enters the plan, {reference} (cash and the estimated value of the positions).

problems.limitMinimumAboveTotal: The minimum alone is above the total that enters the plan, {reference}.
